# Visit Beijing

> > Official English tourism portal for Beijing, featuring the Forbidden City, Great Wall, Summer Palace, and comprehensive travel resources for international visitors.

This is the official English-language website of the Beijing Municipal Bureau of Culture and Tourism, providing authoritative information on Beijing's UNESCO World Heritage Sites, attractions, practical travel services, and tourism news for international travelers.

## Key Topics

- Forbidden City
- Great Wall (Mutianyu and Badaling)
- Summer Palace
- Temple of Heaven
- Ming Tombs
- Tiananmen Square
- Cultural heritage sites
- Historical landmarks
- Royal gardens
- Travel routes and guides
- Beijing tourism services
- International hospitals
- Tourist destinations
- Scenic areas

## Attractions & Destinations

- [Beijing Attractions](https://english.visitbeijing.com.cn/attraction): Main attractions page featuring Forbidden City, Great Wall, and Summer Palace

## Visitor Services & Practical Information

- [Health Service](https://english.visitbeijing.com.cn/article/4JQ2B0iNvQC): Guide to Beijing medical services and international hospitals for visitors

## News & Updates

- [Beijing Tourism News](https://english.visitbeijing.com.cn/news): Beijing tourism news and travel updates from Municipal Bureau of Tourism

## Contact & Support

- [Contact Form](https://english.visitbeijing.com.cn/form): Contact and feedback form for Beijing Tourism enquiries and subscriptions
